headline: Persija Jakarta Players Affected By Influenza Before Match Weekend
seoTitle: Persija Players Hit By Flu Before Persebaya Match
metaDescription: Coach Shin Tae-yong reports that several Persija Jakarta players have contracted influenza ahead of the upcoming league fixture against Persebaya Surabaya.
aiSummaryBullets: Head coach Shin Tae-yong stated that multiple Persija Jakarta players are suffering from influenza.
The illness has impacted the squad's preparation for the upcoming league match against Persebaya Surabaya.
Shin Tae-yong also expressed public dissatisfaction regarding the current condition of the Jakarta International Stadium pitch.
aiContextParagraph: As the Persija Jakarta football club prepares for the ninth week of the 2026/2027 Super League season, head coach Shin Tae-yong reported health issues within his roster. Several key players have fallen ill with influenza, complicating training efforts ahead of the scheduled match against Persebaya Surabaya. Alongside these squad health concerns, the coach voiced criticism regarding the playing surface at the Jakarta International Stadium, despite a recent victory recorded by the team at the venue. These developments highlight the logistical and physical challenges currently facing the club as they look toward their next league engagement. The situation remains a point of focus for supporters and local sports media as the coaching staff evaluates player availability for the upcoming weekend fixture.
whyItIsViral: The story has gained moderate traction across independent news outlets due to the involvement of the high-profile coach and the disruption of a major team's preparation.
